LESSON: CARING FOR WATER ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Caring for the
Topic 3.5: Caring for water environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Caring for water environment. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. participate in keeping stored water safe at home and school
2. appreciate the importance of keeping stored water safe for human and animal use. school learners identify ways of keeping stored water safe. demonstrations on methods of keeping stored water safe at home and in school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. participate in keeping stored water safe at home and school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to participate in keeping stored water safe at home and school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the importance of keeping stored water safe for human and animal use. school learners identify ways of keeping stored water safe. demonstrations on methods of keeping stored water safe at home and in school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of keeping stored water safe for human and animal use. school learners identify ways of keeping stored water safe. demonstrations on methods of keeping stored water safe at home and in school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Caring for water environment.
2. Explain Caring for water environment to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: In groups, learners share keeping stored water safe for experiences on what makes human and animal use. water unsafe in the home and school
4. Show that you can: participate in keeping stored water safe at home and school
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Caring for water environment. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Caring for water environment important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, learners share keeping stored water safe for experiences on what makes human and animal use. water unsafe in the home and school
2. Using multimedia resources, learners identify ways of keeping stored water safe.
3. Learners observe demonstrations on methods of keeping stored water safe at home and in school.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. participate in keeping stored water safe at home and school
2. appreciate the importance of keeping stored water safe for human and animal use. school learners identify ways of keeping stored water safe. demonstrations on methods of keeping stored water safe at home and in school.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
